entry.title: R1P_V2-V2.05.20251011
entry.content:
Original Timmkoo SR1 software **R1P_V2-V2.05.20251011**.
- Model: **SR1** (Timmkoo) - Package: `rom_sr1.zip` - Build tag: `R1P_V2-V2.05.20251011` - Build date: 2025-10-11
## Install
1. Download `rom_sr1.zip` (every numbered volume if the release has more than one, then `cat rom_sr1.zip.* > rom_sr1.zip`). 2. Unzip it. Keep the scatter file next to the images. 3. Open SP Flash Tool, choose **Download Only**, load the scatter file from the archive and flash. 4. Or use Innioasis Updater CE: <https://innioasis.app/guide.html>
This wipes the player. Back up music and recordings first.
